items.name: Instruction packet + plain API + scoped token (the simple door)
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md; built commit ff31e95 (agent-interface Phase 1)
items.summary: Welcome packet in 3 renderings from one source + shared-protocol doors + scoped, expiring, revocable token gate — the only door usable by every agent class today. Built in agent-interface Phase 1 (packet + registration + token record).

items.name: Board + dump doors behind the token gate
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; built commit db6d930 (agent-interface Phase 2)
items.summary: Outside agents work the Agent Commons board and dump intel through the Phase 1 gate (PROPOSE tier); every write carries the agent name tag + owner key.

items.name: Pending-approval machinery (the outward-act gate)
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; built commit db6d930 (agent-interface Phase 2)
items.summary: No agent-callable send/buy/publish exists: an agent files a request, SBOS holds it as a durable pending approval, the owner approves/denies, SBOS records it. Approval executes nothing yet (no execution surface in this phase).

items.name: Scoped reading doors
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md order of work step 5
items.summary: Agents read what their permission record allows — people/last-said, calendar (carry-forward), goals, weekly scorecard — only what the task needs.

items.name: Email as a full door
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (v1 path incl. extra-doors merge); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md
items.summary: Secret per-owner capability address in; digests + approve-by-reply out; aligned SPF/DKIM/DMARC gating; contents treated as untrusted data.

items.name: Wake-up lite
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Event log + changes-since feed + signed outbound webhooks + scheduled-poll recipes per agent host; wake payloads carry IDs/links only, never instructions.

items.name: Folder lite (plain-files exchange folder)
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Inbox / drafts / START-HERE.md, one file per item, git-friendly — the Obsidian/OpenClaw workspace pattern. No built cloud-drive sync.

items.name: ICS calendar feed for due dates
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: One-way calendar feed any calendar app can read; due dates only.

items.name: Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP) — second face on the same API
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md
items.summary: Same doors, scopes and audit projected as a remote MCP server; bearer token first, then OAuth 2.1 sign-in.

items.name: Public doorway for a home-hosted SBOS
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (relay vs tunnel left open)
items.summary: Cloud agents (Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini) can only reach a public HTTPS address, so v2 needs a public doorway. OPEN CHOICE inside the item: relay vs tunnel — not yet ruled.

items.name: Full MCP notifications / push
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Full push wakes ride with the MCP server in v2; v1 carries wake-up lite only.

items.name: Telegram bot (owner only)
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Owner notifications with signed approve buttons + intake. Talks to the OWNER, not their agent — adds no agent capability.

items.name: Middlemen lite: Zapier/n8n/Make recipes + private Zapier app
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Generic webhook/HTTP recipes so existing automations can reach SBOS before any public listing.

items.name: Claude / ChatGPT directory listings
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md
items.summary: Thin per-vendor directory packaging of the same MCP server — packaging, not new building.

items.name: Public middlemen listings, by demand
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST; plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Zapier public listing first (free, ~90-day beta), then an n8n verified node, then Make — sequenced by demand.

items.name: Local MCP as a primary door — RULED OUT
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (skip list); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md
items.summary: Too technical for non-technical owners; an mcp-remote bridge gets documented instead.

items.name: A2A / ACP / AG-UI / agents.json / NANDA — RULED OUT
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (skip list); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md
items.summary: Agent-to-agent delegation and agent-to-UI standards — the wrong job for an agent using a product's tools and data; unadopted for this purpose.

items.name: WhatsApp / Slack / Messenger / SMS product bots — RULED OUT
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (skip list); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Verification, template approval, per-message/registration costs and marketplace gates — for doors that only reach the owner. Telegram only, in v2.

items.name: Product-built Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive sync — RULED OUT
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (skip list); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: Folder lite covers the file door; building cloud sync is heavy, all-or-nothing permissions, conflict-prone.

items.name: Voice / phone door — RULED OUT
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (skip list); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: No standard or product found that lets a customer's own agent enter through it — vapour for this purpose.

items.name: Embedded bring-your-own-agent widget — RULED OUT
items.source: Brian ruling 2026-11-15 08:32 CST (skip list); plan PLAN-2026-11-15.md (extra doors)
items.summary: No standard or product found that lets a customer's own agent enter through an embedded widget — vapour for this purpose.
